verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's own docs describe Projects as a way to organize related chats and give ChatGPT the context it needs. Local projects give those chats access to folders of files on your computer, and MCP servers can be scoped per project. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of project-level shared custom instructions, detail on uploading files into a project (as opposed to linking local folders), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
